caption: The drawing depicts a multi-cavity baking mold rendered in black and gray tones on a beige background. The main object, shown in a perspective view, consists of twelve connected molds of varying shapes, including round, scalloped, heart, and star forms, all joined on a single flat base. The molds are arranged in a somewhat irregular, compact layout. In the upper left corner of the image, there are two additional schematic drawings: a top view and a side elevation of the mold, both outlined in black lines. The top view shows the same arrangement of twelve molds, clearly indicating the distinctive geometric shapes. The side elevation displays the profile of the mold, revealing the depth and the flat bottom supports. There is a small linear scale beneath the side elevation. The drawing is cleanly bordered by a thin black line rectangular frame. Light brownish discoloration is visible in the four corners of the paper. There is a handwritten signature or inscription in the lower left corner.
title: Maple Sugar Mold
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
